seoTitle: Link Purpose Checker: Vague, Duplicate and New-Window Links
metaDescription: Paste HTML to find links with no name, vague text, raw URLs as text, same text for different pages and new windows without a warning.
intro: Reviews links for purpose, names and new-window behaviour.
why:
Screen reader users often browse a list of links, where "click here" means nothing.

The tool finds unnamed links, vague phrases, long URLs as text, repeated link text with different targets, target=_blank without a hint, and file links without a format. Under WCAG 2.4.4 context can fix a vague link, so most items are marked review.
howTo: Rewrite link text to say where it goes.
Mention new windows and file types.

faq.a: No, if the context makes it clear. It is still weak in link lists.

faq.q: Is opening a new tab required to be announced?
faq.a: It is best practice, not a WCAG requirement.
From link text, image alt and aria-label in simplified form.
